scope: Original hierarchy CFG and original Obb distance arithmetic under QEMU. Four hierarchy call targets are redirected to an observer which executes the unchanged original distance leaf. Prepared mesh virtual transforms/OBBs and assertions are explicit services. All caller memory, pointer permutation, cursor, parent/child indices, capacity failures and call order/float32 distance bits are compared. Includes rotated/anisotropic/tiny/zero OBBs, overlap chains, separate sibling groups, disconnected suffixes, ties, ancestor traversal and callback mutations. SoulTrap loader has a composition entry using this actual hierarchy. Real Model initialization, native scene ownership, burning/propagation/reward/network/render/unload and complete classes remain pending.
